earnings.title: eBay Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Revenue of $3.2 billion, up 14% on an as-reported basis and up 13% on an FX-Neutral basis
Revenue was $3.2 billion, up 14% on an as-reported basis and up 13% on a foreign exchange ("FX") neutral basis.
GAAP net income from continuing operations was $501 million, or $1.11 per diluted share.
Non-GAAP net income from continuing operations was $685 million, or $1.51 per diluted share.
GAAP and Non-GAAP operating margins of 19.2% and 26.3%, respectively

quotes.text: eBay’s strong third quarter results reflect continued momentum across our business priorities and customer segments as more consumers embrace recommerce.
quotes.by: Jamie Iannone, Chief Executive Officer at eBay

quotes.text: Our third quarter results demonstrate that eBay’s strategy is delivering strong GMV growth and meaningful earnings expansion.
quotes.by: Peggy Alford, Chief Financial Officer at eBay
